dialog: I'll show you the power of the Palanquin Ship!
Beginning our attack run. Full speed ahead!
Uh oh/ I've gotta hold on to something...
Enemy ahead!
Unzan/ you're in the way/ I can't see!
Wait/ are we really going to fight?!
Course we are!
Please make sure not to harm anyone near the enemy.
I know/ I know!
Looks like they're still near us!
Well then/ we've got to attack back!
The wind's back in our sails/ launch the counterattack!
Do unto others what they did to you/ that's the sailor's way!
They don't know when to quit/ here's our chance!
Don't let those scoundrels get away!/\n ...is what Unzan just said.
Murasa/ don't let them get away!
That's the plan!
We can't let this chance slip away!
We can weather storms even rougher than this!
As long as this ship can still sail/ we fight on!
Now you've done it! I'll show you!
Murasa/ calm down!
If we spread our fire/ some of them are bound to hit!
This will be plenty to keep the enemy in check!
All guns/ remember not to waste your shots!
Fire a spread of danmaku!
Give 'em both barrels! Cancel that/ give 'em all the barrels!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ fire!
Attack them with our Spirit Cannons!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ make all guns ready!
Give them a full broadside!
If you keep dawdling around/ you're gonna get hit!
I'll just let this take its natural course!
The target is ahead! Fire!
Murasa/ please don't hit any of our allies!
The main battery is ready!
Bring the buddhist reactor to full power!
Everything's ready/ Murasa!
Sink down to the bottom!
Main battery/ prepare to fire!
We have a good line of fire!
Fire!!!
Concentrating all the ship's spiritual energy into the main battery!
Adjusting targeting... ready!
Hit them!
Any ship that gets in our way will be sunk!
Eat this!
Continue to concentrate your fire!
Power output rising/ we're ascending!
Sinking Anchor!
We can hit them right now! All guns/ fire at will!
We'll attack from above!
Fire the anchor!
We've hooked them! Fire!
We'll secure the ship's hull and then bombard them.
You won't dodge this anchor!
SINK!
Get the crew back on their feet!
We've got to bring the ship about/ and quick.
Even my Palanquin Ship can't counterattack...
Kosuzu! What's the range to the enemy?!
... Looks far/ Skipper!
Getting revenge is a phantom's specialty!
That was cool!
The Palanquin Ship will take over from here!
Gangway/ gangway! Any one idling around is liable to get hit!
Please/ listen to Unzan and move out of the way!
We'll wedge ourselves between our allies and the enemy!
Screen them with the Palanquin Ship!
Whoa/ watch out!\n I thought we were gonna hit them...
We've come to provide back-up.\n Please be careful!
... I can't let your feelings go to waste!
Shou/ you're not fighting alone out there!
Shou/ don't stretch yourself too thin.
You're too far ahead/ Shou!
Shou/ this is no time for idling!
Nazrin/ even you'd do that for the ship?
Nazrin/ good job finding us a route!
Nazrin/ leave the rest to us!
Nazrin/ don't push yourself too hard!
Oops/ Nazrin's so small that we almost ran her over.
Don't overdo things/ Nue!
Nue/ thanks!
I won't let you hurt Nue!
Nue/ watch out!
Keine gave us a good chance!
We won't flinch/ no matter what you throw at us!
Yeah/ I hope you've learned your lesson!
No matter how stormy the seas we will prevail!
Yeah! You can do it/ Murasa!
You'll never sink our hopes!
Absolutely. This ship sails for Hijiri!
Murasa/ they're above us!
Yeah/ I got it!
Murasa/ they're coming from the right!
Thanks/ Kosuzu.
Murasa/ dodge to the left!
Roger that!
Confirming whether we actually took any damage...
Huh/ did something just hit us right now?
Who knows?\n If something did/ it was barely noticeable.
That's my Palanquin Ship for you! Absolutely dauntless.
Don't be overconfident. Let's keep it careful.
How dare you scratch my Palanquin Ship with such a boring―
Settle down/ settle down.
In such perilous times/ we must all band together!...\n is what Unzan just said.
This captain is prepared to go down with her ship...
Don't jinx us!
At this rate/ even the Palanquin Ship is going to―
I can't show my face to Hijiri after this...
Close all the bulkheads! Protect the main shrine!
I knew it/ the rudder's just not good enough to keep up!
Less excuses/ more preparing for the next one/ please.
Hey!\n We can't take manymore hits like that!
You don't need to tell me/ I'm trying!
Don't look at me like that/ I'm gonna dodge the next one!
All hands/ brace for impact!
I've already been bracing for a while now!
Unzan/ when the time comes/ help keep us in the air!
The Palanquin Ship's not gonna sink like this!
If we're gonna get hit/ then make sure we take it on the thickest part of the armour belt!
Easier said than done/ Ichirin...
I guess I just don't have enough training...
Even the sutras have a few misspellings.
I- is this normal?!
This is nothing compared to when the sky's dark and the sea's roaring!
You did it/ Skipper/ good show!\n ...is what Unzan just said.
Hah/ you can't even hit a target this big?
It's because we have such a skilled helmsman.
We'll sail right through this sea of danmaku!
We dodged it... wait/ no/ we grazed it?!
W- whoaaa!
We had to go to flank speed/ but we shook them off!
We're coming about hard/ hold on to something!
Wow!\n So this is what a 'barrier' is!
Makes for smooth sailing/ huh?
We were protected by the power of Hijiri's Buddhism!
Sure/ let's go with that.
I'll parry it... with my ship!
That's a new one.
Welcome aboard!
We're gonna give you a REAL warm welcome!
Seize the initiative―This I command!
Don't get too carried away.
I'm sorry/ Hijiri...\n I wasn't able to protect your place to come home to...
I can't show my face to Hijiri after this...
Our ride for Hijiri... sank...
Murasa/ are we going to―
I know/ I know!\n I've got to suppress Yatagarasu's power!
Whatever it takes/ I need more power!
Sure/ no problem.\n Let's show her how much we care in just one shot!
Aaaaaaaah!
